This video showcases free video editing software for beginners. It's a Premiere Pro or Davinci Resolve alternative for free. You can edit photos on Linux or Windows using Kdenlive and in this video I test whether it's the best free editing software for content creators to edit 4k footage. Kdenlive is a free editing program and it doesn't require a subscription like Capcut or Premiere, but it's also fully free unlike DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro. Why are you still reading this?
